description: This file contains a C# class implementing a test grain for a distributed application, with methods for setting targets and stress testing via asynchronous calls.

classes.name: ClientAddressableTestGrain
classes.description: A test grain class implementing interface IClientAddressableTestGrain, used for testing client-server interactions and stress testing asynchronously.

methods.name: SetTarget
methods.description: Sets the target object for communication.

methods.name: HappyPath
methods.description: Delegates a message to the target's OnHappyPath method.

methods.name: SadPath
methods.description: Delegates a message to the target's OnSadPath method.

methods.name: MicroSerialStressTest
methods.description: Performs a serial stress test by calling target.OnSerialStress repeatedly and asserting results.

methods.name: MicroParallelStressTest
methods.description: Performs a parallel stress test by launching multiple tasks calling target.OnParallelStress and asserting results.
